name: Resistance Band Row

instructions.description: Sit or stand with a resistance band anchored securely in front of you.
Hold the band ends with arms extended and shoulders relaxed.
Pull the elbows back while squeezing the shoulder blades gently together.
Return the arms forward with control without letting the shoulders round excessively.

performanceMetrics.notes: Perform smooth repetitions with constant band tension.

variations.variationDescription: Uses elastic resistance instead of free weight while keeping a horizontal pulling pattern.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use machine resistance if available in another setting.

commentsNotes: Do not shrug as you pull.
